verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents several noise-reduction levers: learnings from team feedback, path filters that skip lock, binary and generated files, incremental reviews that cover only new changes, and a findings view for deciding what to fix first. Hands-on reports are mixed: one team removed it as too verbose with too many false positives, while another user praised its clean, actionable reviews. Missing for 10: explicit severity labels on comments, any documented deduplication of comments, measured or independent evidence of a low false-positive rate.
